answer_1.quote: Cross-lingual summarization (CLS) helps people efficiently grasp salient information from articles in a foreign language... We name our model Multi-task Cross-Lingual Abstractive Summarization (MCLAS) under limited resources.
answer_1.outputs: monolingual summaries and cross-lingual summaries generated by the unified decoder

answer_2.quote: We reimplement a variety of models and evaluate them using F1 scores of the standard ROUGE metric (ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L) and BERTScore.

answer_4.quote: Seven graduate students with high levels of fluency in English and Chinese are asked to assess the generated summaries and gold summaries from independent perspectives: informativeness, fluency, and conciseness. We follow the Best-Worst Scaling method ...
answer_4.guideline: Assess each summary on informativeness, fluency, and conciseness using Best-Worst Scaling.
